entries.original:
"You don’t even know what it is and
you’ve already accepted?

You’re so bold!

No wonder you were able to make it
through the Tomb of Borrius!

Well, here’s my request.

I’m sure you noticed that there
wasn’t much treasure lying around\lin the tomb.

It’s known around here that the
ancient people of Borrius used\lspecial materials to camouflage\ltheir treasure.

So, I want you to go back to the
tomb and find every item the\lancient people hid.

Do you think you can do it?"

できそうですか？

entries.original:
"Oh, pay me no mind.
I was merely talking to myself.

I am Véga, the Leader of the
Crater Town Gym.

When I first arrived here, I felt
comfort in the sombre atmosphere\lof this town.

My Pokémon and I therefore
trained here, to hone our skills\lto the apex.

Incidentally, are you afraid of
the dark?

Many people are.

Knowing exactly what you’re up
against gives people courage.

But when they stumble blindly, never
sure when the foe will approach\.

Fear destroys even the largest
armies.

Let’s see if you, too, will be
crushed by the heavy atmosphere\land my might!"

"Howdy there, partner.
Good to see ya again so soon.

I hope my humble abode is to yer
likin’ and all.

If not, I’m sure there’s somethin’
else around ya can keep yer\leyes on\.

I mean, it’s clear ya went all
over this here town and the next,\llookin’ for li’l old me.

\.I kid, I kid.

That look there tells me yer not
battlin’ me fer fun.

Look, I ain’t one to pry.
That’s none o’ my beeswax.

But as Gym Leader, I can’t just up
and fork over a Badge to any ol’\lcowpoke.

So, let’s just get this on.

Let this handsome fella test
yer mettle!"
